traits.name: Fire Form
traits.text:
The mote can enter a hostile creature’s
space and stop there.

traits.name: Annoying
traits.text:
An enemy in the same space as a
mote must make a DC 14 Dexterity (Acrobatics)
save when it moves. On a failed save, the mote
moves with it. While in the same space as a mote,
enemies have disadvantage on Constitution
checks to maintain concentration.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The mote makes three touch attacks.

actions.name: Touch
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach
5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) fire damage.
